About Us
Lakireddy Bali Reddy College of Engineering (LBRCE) was founded through Lakireddy Bali Reddy Charitable Trust in 1998 by eminent philanthropist and NRI Entrepreneur Sri Lakireddy Bali Reddy, a Chemical Engineer by qualification. Since the inception, LBRCE aims at co-creating value-based technical excellence, which ultimately leads to the development of the rural area where the college is situated. (Read more...)
Vision
To empower the students to become technologically vibrant, innovative and emotionally matured; and to train them to face the challenges of the quality-conscious globalized world economy.
Mission
To provide an environment most conducive to learning and to create a stimulating intellectual atmosphere on the campus.
To achieve Academic Excellence.
To ensure a holistic development of personality.
To spread education to rural areas.
To establish partnership between Institution & Industry.
Quality Policy
LBRCE is committed to impart quality Technical Education and Training, so as to prepare dynamic and socially responsible technocrats for effective nation-building by recruiting dedicated and competent faculty, providing state-of–the-art Infrastructure and equipment that encompasses the stated University Curriculum and beyond.
Sri Lakireddy Bali Reddy, Founder Chairman
Sri Lakireddy Bali Reddy, an Indo-american entrepreneur, philanthropist hails from Velvadam, a village in the Mylavaram mandal of Krishna District, Andhra Pradesh. A meritorious student throughout his academic career, he graduated from Osmania University with a Gold medal in B.E in Chemical Engineering. Soon after, he went to the University of California at Berkeley on a scholarship in 1960 and completed MS in Chemical Engineering.
A man of boundless energy and ideas, he envisioned himself in the role of an entrepreneur in the hotel and real estate business. Within a few decades, through sheer hard work and determination, he was successful in establishing a flourishing business empire. A man with considerable compassion and generosity, he took immense pleasure in doing many acts of charity and philanthropy that benefited his beloved place of birth and its people. He set up Lakireddy Bali Reddy Charitable Trust, a non-profit organization fully funded by him in order to channelize the multi-faceted philanthropic activities towards the socio-economic and educational development of this region of Krishna District. He strived to improve the lot of the poor and helpless as well. (Read more...)

WATER ROCKET from Department of Aerospace Engineering
What is Water Rocket?
Building and launching rockets is just enormously enjoyable. It combines the simple pleasure of watching in awe at the power of a compressed gas, with the rather more subtle pleasure of mastering an engineering problem. In short, it’s fun for all ages.
How does it work?
The compressed air is added and pressurizes the contents of the bottle. The bottle is released from the pump. The water is pushed out through the nozzle by the compressed air. The bottle moves away from the water because it follows Newton's Third Law.
What we provide?
Foot pump and launcher will be provided to launch your rocket.
When and where?
Date and Time of the event: 28th December 2022 Venue: LBRCE football ground
BUG HUNTER from Department of AI & DS
What is a Bug?
A bug is a coding error in a computer program
Types of bugs
Functional errors
Syntax errors (semicolons, etc)
Logic errors (wrong results)
Calculation errors (using wrong algorithm for calculation)
Out of bounds bugs (length exceeded)
To find bugs, two things are crucial: software debugging and disassembly. Debugging entails actively monitoring the software's execution to understand its functions and how it carries them out. Software developers regularly use this technique to find and fix software bugs (security-related or not) when a program misbehaves or when a bug manifests itself during program execution, but they've detected no problems with the source code.
Task
To Manually find bugs, individuals do need:
Common sense (to know what to look for)
Dedication (to spend endless hours poking through software code)
A bit of luck (to find meaningful results).
Here the participant will give a piece of code. In which they have to find the bugs which are stopping the program execution.
Note:
Piece of code can be given in any language or just an algorithm
Your task is to find number of bugs and proper reason for that bug

Create a innovative model within the given time provided using material like paper waste, cutboards, thermocol sheets and spoons etc. Participants should justify the design and explain to the judge.
Guidelines:

Need complete with in time.
Usage of Smartphone’s s are restricted.
WHO IS THE KGF? from Department of CSE
Objective:
Coding contest aims foster learning and growth among participants who are passionate about programming through healthy competition.
Improves the problem-solving capabilities among all the participants.
Makes participants efficient, focused and fast.
Test Pattern:
Number of Problems
Test Duration
Three Logic building problems with the following language options
90 Minutes
C / C++/ Java / Python
You can choose any one of the above programming language.
Test will be conducted in an online platform.
Individual participation from any college.
We will provide test login credentials to all the registered participants during test.
Systems will be provided in the college (i.e. Block-I, CSE Department), no need to bring your laptops.
For each and every problem certain test cases will be provided, to get full marks all test cases should be passed.
All the logic building problems carries equal marks.
The candidates who will solve more problems within less span of time will be awarded as winners.
Rules & Regulations:
Test will be conducted in full screen mode, tab switches not allowed. If any violations during the test, it will be automatically submitted.
No cell phones or other secondary devices in the room or test area.
No use of additional applications or internet
Don’t speak with your friends or others during the exam.
No other devices in view during this exam
Argument with test observers in any form will lead to the disqualification of the test.
Rules & Eligibility:
All the regular students with a valid identity card of their respective Educational Institutes/Colleges are eligible to participate in the event.

To secure your place, please send an email to:

Aptitude test
Logical and critical reasoning
2 nd will be Verbal and communication test.
3 rd will be a Technical interview round.

Create your innovative thoughts into reality by the Electronics and Instrumentation core knowledge.
Come with working prototype of your application.
Display and deliver the information about your futuristic application.
BRAIN EXPEDITIOUS from Department of IT
Brain expeditious is a test of knowledge in various fields like technical & non-technical.
Task:
The students should sound knowledge in various fields like General Knowledge, identify the pictures/photos of famous persons, and programming, etc.
In this event there are 3 rounds.
General Knowledge
Picture describing and Item Advertising
Drag and Drop
YANTHRORA (ROBO SPRINT) from Department of Mechanical Engineering
The robots build by given dimensions and specifications will be allowed for the game.
If the participants fail to get their own robot, the organisers shall provide a kit. Please note that the same robot will be given to other participants falling in to the same criteria. Hence, it is highly recommended to make your own kit.
The rounds will be decided according to groups participated.
The robot which gains maximum points will be the winner.
The each team should not consist of more than 2 members.
Both members from the same college is not mandatory.
The robot should follow the robot specifications provided. Any deviation from the mentioned specifications will lead to disqualification.
No test practice will be allowed on the main arena.
Terminals for charging the battery will be provided in the college.
The arena may be subjected to change before the commencement of any round.
If the Robot crosses a checkpoint, and moves off track, then the Robot would be placed back on the previous checkpoint crossed.
During the game play, if any part of a robot is destructed/ dismantled/ damaged, the participant will be given a timeout to repair at an expense of a penalty, while the next participant will be called for the play.
The decision of the judges will be final and abiding. Argument with judges in any form will lead to the disqualification of the team.
Eligibility:
All regular students with a valid identity card of their respective Educational Institutes are eligible to participate in the event.
ROBOT Specifications:
Lego kits are strictly not allowed in any form.
The L X B X H should not exceed 25 X 25 X 25 cms.
The net weight of robot should not exceed 3 kg.
However a tolerance of 5% is acceptable with the permission of the judge.
Power source should be on board (i.e., on the robot body placed in the arena).
Wired or wireless robots are allowed to use.
If RF (Wireless) controller is used, dual frequency is a must in order to avoid RF jamming. The dual frequency should be such that it can be switched to either frequency just before the start of the run.
The length of the wire (for wired bots) should be long enough to cover the whole track (around 17m or more) and the wire should remain slack during the complete run.
The maximum allowed voltage to power the robot is 24V.
BULLS vs BEARS from Department of MBA
Stock Market Game Rules:
A stock market game is an event that attempts to reproduce or duplicate some or all features of a live stock market on a computer so that a player may practice trading stocks without financial risk. Stock market game is a simulated trading process in which would-be investors can 'practice ‘investing without committing real money. This is done by the manipulation of imaginary money and investment positions that behave in a manner similar to the real markets. New investors can practice making fortunes time and time again before actually committing financially. Stock market game is often used for educational purposes.
Rules:
Registration fee:Rs 300/- per team
Team consists of 2 Members
Test contains 25 questions – with 15 minutes duration
Teams are filtered according to the merit to the next round
It consists of 2 rounds – to test the financial IQ of participants
Abbreviations, Currencies, Logical thinking
Buying and selling of securities according to the market information
Three members for a team
Judges decisions will be final
Technology is strictly prohibited

About LBRCE
About Lakireddy Bali Reddy College of Engineering (LBRCE)
Lakireddy Bali Reddy College of Engineering (LBRCE) was founded through Lakireddy Bali Reddy Charitable Trust in 1998 by eminent philanthropist and NRI Entrepreneur Sri Lakireddy Bali Reddy, a Chemical Engineer by qualification. Since the inception, LBRCE aims at co-creating value-based technical excellence, which ultimately leads to the development of the rural area where the college is situated.
Lakireddy Bali Reddy College of Engineering (LBRCE), approved by AICTE and affiliated to JNTUK, Kakinada is an Autonomous Institution since 2010 and has been accredited by NAAC with 'A' Grade (3.20 / 4 in Cycle-2), NBA (ASE, CE, CSE, IT, ECE, EEE, & ME) under Tier-I and ISO 21001:2018, 14001:2015, 50001:2018 Certified . It has also been recognized as ‘Scientific and Industrial Research Organization (SIRO)’ by Department of Scientific and Industrial Research (DSIR), Ministry of Science and Technology, Government of India, ‘Host Institution’ and ‘Business Incubator’ by IIC. It has also been awarded 2(f) and 12(B) status and Recognized as a 'Colleges with Potential for Excellence' (CPE) by UGC. It ranked 201-300 band (Under Engineering), NIRF-2024, ranks in 101-150 Rank Band in NIRF India Innovation Rankings - 2023 and ranked 251-300 band (Under Engineering) in NIRF India Rankings - 2022, 201-250 band (Under Engineering) in NIRF India Rankings - 2020. At present, we offer 9 B.Tech programs in CSE, CSE (AI&ML), AI & DS, IT, ECE, EEE, CE, ASE, ME and 4 M.Tech programs in Data Science, Thermal Power Engg., Power Electronics & Electrical Drives, VLSI and Embedded Systems Design, apart from M.B.A . Operating from a 65-acre green landscaped campus in Mylavaram, major facilities include 7 advanced labs, Internet with 2120 Mbps bandwidth, Digital library, 500KWp solar PV system, Indoor and Outdoor stadium, Gym, Yoga center, NSS unit, NCC Girls wing, Girls and Boys hostels. The teaching-learning process is handled by highly-qualified and experienced faculty. In R&D, we currently handle 12 projects sanctioned by DST, Govt. of India, UGC, and AICTE amounting to Rs 7 Crores, besides 29 patents and 1150+ research publications. Also 5 depts. function as research centers of JNTUK, Kakinada.

FOUNDER CHAIRMAN
Sri Lakireddy Bali Reddy (Late),
M.S., U.S.A.
Founder Chairman, LBRCE
About Founder Chairman:
Sri Lakireddy Bali Reddy (Late) , an Indo-american entrepreneur, philanthropist hails from Velvadam, a village in the Mylavaram mandal of Krishna District, Andhra Pradesh. A meritorious student throughout his academic career, he graduated from Osmania University with a Gold medal in B.E in Chemical Engineering . Soon after, he went to the University of California at Berkeley on a scholarship in 1960 and completed MS in Chemical Engineering . A man of boundless energy and ideas, he envisioned himself in the role of an entrepreneur in the hotel and real estate business. Within a few decades, through sheer hard work and determination, he was successful in establishing a flourishing business empire. A man with considerable compassion and generosity, he took immense pleasure in doing many acts of charity and philanthropy that benefited his beloved place of birth and its people. He set up Lakireddy Bali Reddy Charitable Trust, a non-profit organization fully funded by him in order to channelize the multi-faceted philanthropic activities towards the socio-economic and educational development of this region of Krishna District . He strived to improve the lot of the poor and helpless as well. Some of his notable philanthropic activities include:
Providing pensions to the old, poor and the destitute
Providing free eye care services including free cataract surgery with lens implants
Building a Secondary School on the outskirts of Velvadam and donating it the Zillaparishad
Donated school building to Upper Primary School at Velvadam
Supply of drinking water during summer
Laying road network with drainage in Velvadam
In 1998, against many odds, he founded the Lakireddy Bali Reddy college of Engineering with the able support of his younger sibling, Sri Lakireddy Jayaprakash Reddy . And as its chairman, he made it blossom into a thriving center of technical education for providing quality education and employment opportunities to the young. True to his vision, the college is marching ahead as a top ranked Technical institute in the state of Andhra Pradesh that takes pride for its best-in-class infrastructure, excellent academic ambience and robust research potential. The octogenarian NRI philanthropist, Sri Bali Reddy beautifully lives the tag of the son of the soil by holding his beloved birthplace and people very close to his heart.

About eyantra Lab
The Centre for Robotics Studies (CRS) is designed to foster inter disciplinary collaborations research among various branches in order to create and innovative sustainable technological solutions, capable of addressing many societal and environmental issues. The director Dr. E. V. Prasad took special interest to see that a robotics center is set up in the college to aggrandize robotics importance in engineering studies. His tireless efforts and continuous support to the students has led to the establishment of CRS, which is the first student operated research laboratory in the college.
Inauguration Details:
***Dept. of EEE conducted online Inauguration of e-yantra Lab on 01-03-2016 at LBRCE.
A robotics lab in association with IIT-Bombay has been inaugurated in Lakireddy Bali Redy College of Engineering, which is one of the few elite colleges in Andhra Pradesh to install this laboratory. The e-Yantra robotics lab, formerly Center for Robotics Studies, is a product of the e-Yantra Lab Setup initiative by IIT-Bombay, aims at equipping students with the necessary skills needed for a robotics engineer and make them acquainted with the recent advancements in the robotics industry. The laboratory inauguration was carried by opening the signage board by the Director Dr. E. V Prasad in the presence of principal Dr. N.R.M.Reddy and Dr. M Umavani, HOD-EEE Dept., and other dignitaries. The entire inauguration was hosted online through which dignitaries from IIT-Bombay Professor Kavi Arya, Professor Saraswathi Krithivasan and Professor Krishna Lala attended the inauguration.

About NI LabVIEW
Origin of NI LabVIEW:
National Instruments transforms the way engineers and the scientists around the world design, prototype and deploy systems for Engineering Applications. The National Instruments Academic Program aims to improve the quality of Engineering education through their tools which enable hands-on and experimental learning. The NI LabVIEW graphical system design and NI real-time hardware platforms provide hands-on design opportunities to faculty and students. Laboratory Virtual Engineering Work Bench LabVIEW is a Graphical programming language.
Objective:
National instruments, strongly believe in bridging the gap between Industry and Academia. In this connection National instruments started “NI Competence Development Program (CDP)” at Lakireddy Bali Reddy College of Engineering, Mylavaram to encourage the students to “Do Engineering” with Graphical System Design Platform of NI. The main objectives of the centre are:
To provide a conducive environment and facilities for development of technical credence and domain expertise amongst faculty members& studentsat the Institute.
To bridge the gap of instrumentation for interdisciplinary requirements.
To utilise the facility for community development in and around the region.
Inauguration Details:
National Instruments LabVIEW Centre of Excellence (COE) at our institute was inaugurated on 22-02-2011 in the Department of Electrical and Electronics Engineering by the Hon’ble Chairman, Er. Lakireddy Bali Reddy Garu & Mr. Karun Jain, National Instruments, Bangalore as the guest of Honor.
Key Benefits of NI LabVIEW Academy based CDP program at LBRCE Campus:
The academy offers courses for all levels of LabVIEW proficiency and on various hardware platforms. These courses are intended for B.Tech students of all disciplines and provide them opportunity to obtain three-part NI LabVIEW certification named as CLAD, CLD & CLA. These Certifications indicates a broad working knowledge of the LabVIEW environment and validate their skills at a professional level. To make the certifications and trainings at par with NI International standards, the training contents and course material is kept same as used by NI-Labview Academy Community globally.
Key Benefits:
NI will train LBRCE faculties on LabVIEW software platform & Measurement and Automation hardware platform.
NI will recognize LBRCE as authorized training and certification centre to conduct LabVIEW Core 1 & 2 courses at campus for the internal and external students.
After the successful completion of the course, LBRCE can issue certificate with NI logo to the participants.
After the Successful completion of the course, the students can appear for globally recognized certification exam CLAD and passing the exam will enable the students to get job in core engineering industries.
The same facility can be extended to provide consultancy for small and medium enterprises (SMEs).

About NMDC
Origin of NMDC:
A National MEMS Design Centre (NMDC) at our institute has been established in the year 2011 under National Program on Micro and Smart Systems (NPMASS) for the benefit of users from the nearby isolated region. LBRCE motivates the research activity in the field of Micro Electro Mechanical Systems (MEMS) by proper utilization of the facilities provided by NPMASS from design to fabrication of prototype MEMS products and specific field applications. LBRCE will also facilitate external researchers, faculty and graduate/post graduate students from other interested institutes (academic or National Labs subject to individual software licensing conditions) to use the provided design tools. This MEMS network centre is a centralized laboratory for creating new modules of MEMS based devices.
Inauguration Details:
National MEMS Design Centre (NMDC) at our institute has been inaugurated on 22-02-2011 in the Department of Electronics and Instrumentation Engineering by the Hon’ble Chairman, Er. Lakireddy Bali Reddy Garu & Prof. S. Mohan (Centre for Excellence – Nano Electronics), Indian Institute of Science (IISc), Bangalore as the guest of Honor. NMDC was established with the support and collaboration of Indian Institute of Science (IISc), Bangalore under NPMASS Program (National Program on Micro and Smart Systems), and Govt. of India.
About NPMASS:
The National Program on Micro and Smart Systems (NPMASS) has been launched after the success of National Program on Smart Materials (NPSM), which is a unique program, working towards the basic aim of creating awareness in India about MEMS and Smart Systems. The NPMASS under Government of India is wholly supported by Defence Research & Development Organization (DRDO) through Aeronautical Development Agency (ADA), and is endorsed by the five departments DRDO, Department of Space (DOS), Department of Science and Technology (DST), Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR) and Department of Information Technology (DIT).

About SDC
The Skill Development Centre shall seek to impart professional training to students in order to make them industry-ready through enhancement ofskill sets. At a time of rapid changes in the technology front, it will help students to stay updated with the latest technical knowhow, including tools and technologies.The centre imparts training programs in training in various domains as well as soft skills, offered in both blended format as well as Face-to-Face hands-on Training by external and internal organisationsfor accelerated employability. The Skill Development centre of LBRCE initiates Skill-Enhancement Programs in collaboration with reputed International organizations like Indo-Universal Collaboration for Engineering Education (IUCEE), i2E program from North-eastern University , Boston USA and National agencies such as NME-ICT Remote Centres and Spoken-Tutorial,IIT Bombay , SWAYAM PRABHA ,NME-ICT , MHRD ,Govt.of India , NPTELfrom IITs andAndhra Pradesh skill development corporation (APSSDC). It also regularly organizes workshops, seminars and FDPs for both students and faculty in order to help them upgrade their knowledge and skills levels. The SDC centre also conducts special training programs for slow learners among SC/ST students as a part of the curriculum to help them cope up with the required leaning standards. The centre provides special industry-readiness training in Aptitude, Verbal ability as well as Communication & Soft skills drawing expertise from the in-house training resource persons form Centre for Career Guidance & Training (CGT) for better placement of students. Other than using the services of the in-house resource persons, this centre invites experts from the corporate world, academia to train and guide students for better career opportunities. With enhanced skill levels and winning attitude, we expect our students bag attractive career opportunities, thereby contributing to all round socio-economic progress and wellbeing of the society around us, in general and the families of the students, in particular. Also, this centre organize awareness programs on entrepreneurship; liaisons with industry bodies and other agencies in incubating and facilitating start up ventures by students.The centre also offers guidance on career planning, apart from behaviouralcounselling in order to make students feel emotionally secure, confident and practical while facing the various professional challenges in future.

Committee Members

Objectives of the IEEE-CIS Student Chapter:
Establishing a LBRCE Computational Intelligence Society (CIS) Student Chapter is a fantastic way to bridge the gap between academic theory and the rapidly evolving world of AI, Neural Networks, and Evolutionary Computing
To make the chapter successful, the objectives should balance technical skill-building, professional networking, and innovation . Below are the core objectives categorized by their impact.
Technical Excellence & Skill Development:
The primary goal is to move students beyond basic classroom coding and into the "intelligence" aspect of computing.
Hands-on Workshops: Regular sessions on Neural Networks, Fuzzy Systems, and Evolutionary Computation.
Project Incubation: Establish a "Project Lab" for real-world problems such as autonomous drones, medical diagnostic tools, and financial forecasting models.
Reading Groups: Weekly paper review sessions using recent research papers from IEEE Xplore to stay updated with State-of-the-Art (SOTA) technologies.
Professional Growth & Networking:
Connecting students with the broader IEEE community and industry leaders.
Distinguished Lecturer Programs (DLP): Invite global experts for virtual or in-person talks using IEEE resources.
Mentorship Pipeline: Pair senior students or alumni with juniors for guidance on internships and research.
Industry Visits: Organize visits to tech hubs and AI startups to showcase real-world CI applications.
Competitions & Collaborative Learning:
Fostering a spirit of healthy competition and teamwork.
Hackathons & Datathons: Internal competitions focused on algorithm optimization and data preprocessing.
Participation in Global Contests: Training teams for IEEE CIS international competitions like Humanoid Robot and Data Mining challenges.
Inter-disciplinary Collaboration: Partner with Biology and Mechanical Engineering departments for projects in Bioinformatics and Robotics.
Community & Ethical Awareness:
Ensuring the next generation of engineers understands the "why" behind the "what."
Ethics in AI Seminars: Discussions on bias, privacy, ethical AI, and the future of work.
Outreach Programs: Visits to local schools to demonstrate basic AI concepts and inspire STEM careers.

About Spirit of AI Club
Objectives of the Club:
To create a platform to encourage the hidden talents of the students.
To improve the technical and non-technical skills of the students.
To Share the knowledge among the members they acquired by reading books.
Membership and Procedure for Enrollment:
All the students of the department are members of the Departmental Association.
Membership is valid throughout their graduation for 4 years.
Membership fee will be decided by the managing committee.
Termination of Membership:
Faculty Managing Committee has reserved right to terminate membership of any student member.
Managing Committee - Powers and Duties of Managing Committee:
Student’s committee comprises of President, Vice President Ministers and Event Managers.
Head of the department will be the Honorary President
Faculty Advisers has privilege to appoint President, Vice president, Ministers and Event Managers.
Honorary President / Faculty Advisers has reserved right to Schedule or Cancel any event to be organized in the department under the Association banner.
Meeting of the Managing Committee:
Meetings will be conducted at regular intervals.
Faculty Advisers will schedule the meeting to plan/design the events, review the events conducted and to grant funds for future events etc.

Campus Placement Highlights
Department of Artificial Intelligence and Data Science is offering B.Tech in AI&DS-180 Seats
Welcome
B. Tech. in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science (AI &DS) is an undergraduate programme with advanced learning solutions imparting knowledge of advanced innovations like artificial intelligence, data science, machine learning and deep learning. The main goal of artificial intelligence (AI) and data science (DS) is to program computers to use example data or experience to solve a given problem. This specialized B.Tech. course is specially designed to enable students to build intelligent machines, software, or applications with a cutting-edge combination of machine learning, analytics and visualization technologies. The Department of Artificial Intelligence & Data Science at the LBRCE was established in 2020 with an intake of 60 students and the intake was subsequently increased to 120 students in the year 2021.
VISION
To impart Quality Education and produce innovative and Ethical Engineers in the Domain of Artificial Intelligence and Data Science.
MISSION
To Impart Strong foundation of statistics for understanding data science and develop self-sustained professionals.
To establish high performance computational facilities and tools to develop innovative and intelligent solutions.
To collaborate with renowned industries and institutions for multidisciplinary research and development.
To impart value-based education and lifelong learning skills in developing AI and DS based solutions for the satisfaction of all stakeholders.

AERO MODELING CLUB
Objectives
Objectives of the Club
Aeromodelling is the activity involving design, development and flying of small air vehicles. It is a very exciting and interesting way to learn, apply and understand science and engineering principles. Aeromodelling generally involves small sized flying objects like Radio Controlled Aircraft (RC Aircraft), Gliders, Ornithopters, Boomerangs and Paper Planes. Although Aeromodelling looks like a lot of Aerospace/ Aeronautical engineering topic, it involves a lot of interdisciplinary concepts from from various streams of engineering - primarily Aerospace/ Aeronautical, Mechanical, Electronics, Electrical and Computer Science. Aeromodelling gives a good understanding of the roles each of these engineering skills play in real aircraft industry and provides enormous opportunities to develop innovative thinking and implementation. While designing an aero-model is highly based on engineering principles, flying part of Aeromodelling is also considered to be an expensive hobby/ sport.

B.Tech (ASE) - 2026 Brochure
Welcome
Aerospace is a specialised branch of engineering which deals with the design and development of Flying Vehicles such as aircrafts, rockets and space crafts. The course curriculum covers aspects of two branches of engineering - Aeronautical and Astronautical Engineering. The course also focuses on new technologies in aviation, defence systems and space exploration. The original term for Aerospace Engineering was Aeronautical Engineering but after the advancement of technology include aircraft entering into outer space the term was replaced to Aerospace Engineering. It comes under engineering courses. It is the demanding and challenging branch of engineering. The department is Accredited by National Board of Accreditation (NBA) under Tier – I for the three academic years, 2023-24 to 2025-26.
VISION
To achieve academic excellence and produce highly competent professionals in the field of Aerospace Engineering.
MISSION
To impart high quality education in Aerospace Technology through class room teaching and laboratory practices.
To develop indigenous Aerospace Technology by carrying out research in collaboration with industry and research organizations.
To train and inspire the student community to possess effective communication and leadership skills with ethical values
To harness the technological development by being consistently aware of societal needs and challenges

How to Reach LBRCE?
Nearest Bus Station: Pandit Nehru Bus Station (PNBS), Krishnalanka, Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh - 520001 --> which is approximately 46 Kms from College. Following Buses will reach you to college: 1) Bus Number 350 (Vijayawada to Mylavaram) - Metro Service / Ordinary Service --> Available in City/Metro Bus Stop 2) Express Buses Routes --> Vijayawada to Tiruvuru, Vijaywada to Bhadrachalam --> Available in PNBS Departure Block
Nearest Railway Station: Vijayawada Junction Railway Station, Vinchipeta, Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh - 520001 --> which is approximately 48 Kms from College. From Railway Station, take an auto or bus and reach PNBS Bus Station.
Nearest Airport: Vijayawada International Airport, NH16, Gannavaram, Andhra Pradesh - 521102 --> which is approximately 70 Kms from College. From airport, take a cab or bus and reach PNBS Bus Station.

The main objective of the IEI student Chapter:
It is a connection between theory to practical

Campus Placement Highlights
Civil Department Brochure 2026
LBRCE - Dept. of Civil Engineering -- entered MOU with Garudalytics Pvt Ltd, Hyderabad on 19th Nov 2022 for 1 year.
Student Placement Details
Welcome
The Department of Civil Engineering was established in the year 2012, with B.Tech in Civil Engineering degree programme with an intake of 60 students. The department focuses on making the students strong in both technical and practical aspects to meet the national and international requirements. The department plans to establish interaction with industry for improving teaching research and consultancy aspects for continuous development of students, faculty and institution. It is a fast growing discipline in tune with high demands for infrastructure growth in particular due to current situation in the state of Andhra Pradesh. The department is well equipped with very good laboratory facilities for developing practical skills and fundamentals of students. The Department has several laboratories catering to the academic, research and consultancy requirements.
VISION
To make the students strong in both technical and practical aspects to meet the national and international requirements.
MISSION
To provide innovative approaches in teaching –learning process so as to bridge the gap between theory and practice and make the students suitable for meeting national and international requirements
To establish interaction between industry and institution for improvements in teaching research and consultancy aspects for continuous development of students, faculty and institution.
To guide the students for developing ethical and social values besides technical and professional skills leading to their all round development.

Testimonials
Mr. Gopala Krishna N
Deputy Surveyor - AP State Govt
2012 Batch
"I graduated from the Civil Engineering program at LBRCE in 2012. The program provided me with a solid foundation in structural engineering, transportation engineering, and environmental engineering. The hands-on experience gained through laboratory work and field studies prepared me well for my career in the construction industry. I am grateful for the knowledgeable faculty and supportive environment at LBRCE, which helped shape my professional journey."
Mr. Sk. Nazar Vali
Sr.Project Engineer-ECS South West- USA
"My experience as a student in the Civil Engineering program at LBRCE was transformative. The program's emphasis on innovation, sustainability, and community engagement inspired me to pursue a career focused on creating positive impact through engineering. The interdisciplinary approach to learning, coupled with opportunities for research and collaboration, broadened my perspective and prepared me to address complex engineering challenges with creativity and resilience. I am proud to be an alumna of Civil LBRCE and grateful for the invaluable lessons and experiences that have shaped my career."
Mr. N. Harish
Sr. Design Engineer, Ports & Harbour Department, Marine Structures L&T Constructions Pvt Ltd
2014 Batch
"Studying Civil Engineering at LBRCE was a transformative experience for me. The program's rigorous curriculum, coupled with opportunities for internships and co-op placements, provided me with valuable hands-on experience and industry exposure. The faculty members were not only experts in their fields but also passionate mentors who fostered a culture of excellence and innovation. Today, as a practicing civil engineer, I am proud to apply the skills and knowledge I gained at LBRCE-A to make a positive impact in my community."
Mr. Sri Ram Koushik Varanasi
SSr Excutive- Infosys
2016 Batch
"Choosing to pursue my Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering at LBRCEwas one of the best decisions I ever made. The program's comprehensive curriculum covered a wide range of topics, from structural design to transportation planning, allowing me to explore different areas of interest within the field of civil engineering. The supportive learning environment, combined with state-of-the-art facilities and resources, enabled me to excel academically and develop the skills needed to succeed in a competitive industry. I am grateful for the opportunities and experiences I had at LBRCE, which have shaped my career and opened doors to new possibilities."
Ms. M Mounika
Business Development manager - Milestone Technologies
"My journey as a Civil Engineering student at LBRCE was nothing short of exceptional. The program's emphasis on practical, hands-on learning experiences, such as design projects and site visits, allowed me to apply theoretical concepts to real-world engineering challenges. The faculty members were not only knowledgeable educators but also supportive mentors who encouraged critical thinking and problem-solving skills. Today, as a licensed professional engineer, I credit much of my success to the foundation laid at LBRCE, and I am proud to be part of the alumni community."
Mr. A.R. Kishore Reddy
Sr.Engineer - South Central Railway
2018 Batch
"As an alumna of the Civil Engineering department at LBRCE, I can attest to the high-quality education and mentorship I received during my time as a student. The curriculum offered a balanced blend of theoretical knowledge and practical skills, equipping me with the expertise needed to tackle real-world engineering challenges. The faculty members were not only experts in their fields but also dedicated mentors who provided invaluable guidance and support. Today, as a practicing civil engineer, I credit much of my success to the strong foundation laid at LBRCE."

CODE CRACKING CLUB(CCC)
Objectives
Committee Members
Student Members
Objectives and Goals of the Club
Objectives of the Club:
To create awareness among students about programming, coding, and problem-solving. To develop logical thinking and computational problem-solving skills among students. To encourage students to learn and practice different programming languages. To familiarize students with fundamental data structures, algorithms, and programming techniques. To develop students' interest in competitive programming and coding challenges.. To provide practical and hands-on coding experience through regular coding activities. To encourage collaborative learning through team-based coding and problem-solving activities. To provide a platform for students to discuss programming concepts, technologies, and current trends. To encourage participation in inter-college coding contests, hackathons, and technical competitions.
Goals:
Awareness of Programming, Coding, and Problem-Solving Techniques. Discussions on programming concepts, real-world problems, and coding case studies. Understanding Data Structures and Algorithms for efficient problem-solving. Practical and hands-on coding in C, C++, Java, Python, and other programming languages. Debugging and solving real-world programming challenges. Conducting Workshops, Coding Challenges, and Intra-College Hackathons. Encouraging students to participate in Inter-College Coding Competitions and Hackathons.
Outcomes:
Understanding the fundamental concepts of programming and computational problem-solving. Gaining practical experience through coding contests, challenges, and hackathons. Preparing students for technical interviews, coding assessments, placements, and competitive programming.

MACHINE LEARNING (ML) CLUB
Objectives
Committee Members
Student Members
Objectives and Goals of the Club
Objectives of the Club:
To increase awareness among the students about machine learning applications. Educate members on what exactly is ML and its possibilities. Developing the interests of members in ML. To make use of publicly available data sets and libraries in order to demonstrate the applications. To familiarize the students with some basic learning algorithms and techniques and their applications. To encourage collaborative learning. To provide a platform for discussions of current events in ML. Practical and hands-on experience. Inter-college participation.
Goals:
Awareness on Machine Learning and Applications Discussions on ML case studies (by lecturers or any resource persons). Statistical concepts related to ML. Practical and hands-on coding in ML. Debugging real-world challenges. Kaggle challenges Conducting Workshops and Intra College Hackathons.
Outcomes:
Understanding the fundamental concepts of Machine Learning Deploy libraries and explore tools Developing Solutions to the real-world problems using Machine Learning algorithms.

QUANTUM INNOVATION CELL(QIC)
Objectives
Committee Members
Student Members
Objectives and Goals of the Cell
Objectives of the Cell:
To create awareness among students about quantum computing, quantum information, and emerging quantum technologies. To encourage students to explore the applications of quantum computing in real-world problems. To familiarize students with quantum programming platforms, tools, and software frameworks. To provide practical and hands-on experience through quantum programming activities and experiments. To encourage collaborative learning through team-based quantum computing projects and problem-solving activities. To provide a platform for students to discuss recent developments, research, applications, and trends in quantum technologies. To encourage participation in workshops, seminars, hackathons, competitions, and other activities related to quantum technology.
Goals:
Awareness of Quantum Computing, Quantum Information, and Quantum Technologies. Understanding the fundamental principles of quantum mechanics relevant to computing. Understanding Qubits, Quantum Gates, Quantum Circuits, Superposition, Entanglement, and Measurement. Introduction to Quantum Algorithms and their applications in computational problem-solving. Practical and hands-on learning using quantum programming languages, simulators, and platforms. Exploration of quantum applications in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Cryptography, Cybersecurity, Optimization, and other domains. Encouraging students to undertake innovative projects and research in quantum computing and related technologies.
Outcomes:
Understanding the fundamental concepts and principles of quantum computing and quantum information. Developing practical skills in quantum programming and quantum computing platforms. Developing an innovation-oriented and research-oriented mindset among students in the field of quantum technologies.

Overview of the Association
The objective of 'Association of Computer Geeks' is to provide a platform to all the budding software professionals to showcase their talents. The motto of Association of Computer Geeks is “students should bring up themselves to all round professionals with the both technical and managerial capabilities”. In order to achieve this goal many events will be organized in the Department of Computer Science and Engineering under the banner of Association of Computer Geeks. This provides a good opportunity for the organizers to showcase their management skills while the participants enjoy the privilege of demonstrating their talents. Under the guidance of this association, intra college technical events, workshops, training courses will be conducted at regular intervals for the advancement of the students.
Objectives of the Association:
The objective of ‘Association of Computer Geeks’ is to provide a platform to all the budding software professionals to showcase their talents. The motto of Association of Computer Geeks is “students should bring up themselves to all round professionals with the both technical and managerial capabilities”. In order to achieve this goal many events will be organized in the Department of Computer Science and Engineering under the banner of Association of Computer Geeks. This provides a good opportunity for the organizers to showcase their management skills while the participants enjoy the privilege of demonstrating their talents. Under the guidance of this association, intra college technical events, workshops, Seminars and training courses will be conducted at regular intervals for the advancement of the students.
Membership and Procedure for Enrollment:
All the students of the department are members of the Departmental Association. Membership is valid throughout their graduation for 4 years. Membership fee will be decided by the managing committee.
Termination of Membership:
Managing Committee has reserved right to terminate membership of any student member.
Managing Committee - Powers and Duties of Managing Committee::
Managing committee comprises of President, Vice President, Treasurer and Secretary. Head of the department will be the President President has privilege to appoint Vice President, Treasurer and Secretary from the teaching staff. Management Committee has reserved right to Schedule or Cancel any event to be organized in the department under the Association banner. Managing Committee has reserved right to terminate membership of any student member.
Meeting of the Managing Committee:
Meetings will be conducted at regular intervals. President will schedule the meeting to plan/design the events, review the events conducted and to grant funds for future events etc.
Funds and income of the society or its utilisation:
Membership fee will be collected from every student member once throughout his/her graduation.

COMPUTER SCIENCE AND ENGINEERING
Campus Placement Highlights
Welcome
The Department of Computer Science and Engineering at the LBRCE was established in 1998, offers Undergraduate Programs - B.Tech in CSE and Post Graduate Program - M.Tech in Data Science . The B.Tech (Computer Science and Engineering) program was started in the year 1998 with an intake of 40 students and the intake was subsequently increased to 60 students in the year 1999, 90 students in the year 2008, 120 students in the year 2009, 180 students in the year 2019, 240 students in the year 2023, 420 students in the year 2024, 480 students in the year 2025 and 300 students in the year 2026 . The M.Tech. in Data Science program was introduced in the academic year 2023–24 with an approved intake of 06 students. From the academic year 2026–27 onwards, the institute has also started the M.Tech. in Cyber Security program with an approved intake of 06 students. Currently, the institute is equipped with a high-speed Internet connection of 2090 Mbps , providing seamless connectivity to support academic, research, and administrative activities.
VISION
The Computer Science & Engineering aims at providing continuously stimulating educational environment to its students for attaining their professional goals and meet the global challenges.
MISSION
To develop a strong theoretical and practical background across the computer science discipline with an emphasis on problem solving.
To inculcate professional behavior with strong ethical values, leadership qualities, innovative thinking and analytical abilities into the student.
Expose the students to cutting edge technologies which enhance their employability and knowledge.
Facilitate the faculty to keep track of latest developments in their research areas and encourage the faculty to foster the healthy interaction with industry.

About Innovative and Creative Minds (ICM) Club
Objectives of the Club:
The objective of ‘Innovative and Creative Minds’ is to provide a platform to all the budding software professionals to showcase their talents.
The motto of Innovative and Creative Minds is “students should bring up themselves to all round professionals with both technical and managerial capabilities”.
In order to achieve this goal many events will be organized in the Department of Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) under the banner of Innovative and Creative Minds.
This provides a good opportunity for the organizers to showcase their management skills while the participants enjoy the privilege of demonstrating their talents.
Under the guidance of this association, intra college technical events, workshops, Seminars, and training courses will be conducted at regular intervals for the advancement of the students.
Membership and Procedure for Enrollment:
All the students of the department are members of the Departmental Association.
Membership is valid throughout their graduation for 4 years.
Membership fee will be decided by the managing committee.
Termination of Membership:
Faculty Managing Committee has reserved right to terminate membership of any student member.
Managing Committee - Powers and Duties of Managing Committee:
Student’s committee comprises of President, Vice President Ministers and Event Managers.
Head of the department will be the Honorary President
Faculty Advisers has privilege to appoint President, Vice president, Ministers and Event Managers.
Honorary President / Faculty Advisers has reserved right to Schedule or Cancel any event to be organized in the department under the Association banner.
Meeting of the Managing Committee:
Meetings will be conducted at regular intervals.
Faculty Advisers will schedule the meeting to plan/design the events, review the events conducted and to grant funds for future events etc.

Campus Placement Highlights
Department of CSE - Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning is offering B.Tech in AI&DS-240 Seats
Welcome
The B.Tech. Program in CSE - Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning (AI & ML) is an undergraduate programme at LBRCE is designed to provide students with advanced learning solutions in cutting-edge technologies such as artificial intelligence, machine learning, and deep learning. At our department, we are at the forefront of innovation, exploration, and discovery in the dynamic fields of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning. With a commitment to excellence, we invite you to embark on a journey of knowledge, creativity, and growth. The main goal of the department is to equip students with the skills, insights, and experiences they need to thrive in an increasingly AI-driven world. Through rigorous academic programs, hands-on projects, and collaborative research opportunities, we cultivate the next generation of leaders, innovators, and problem-solvers. The Department of CSE (AI & ML) at the LBRCE was established in 2021 with an intake of 60 students and the intake was subsequently increased to 120 students in the year 2023.
VISION
To pioneer transformative advancements that redefine the boundaries of intelligence, empower individuals and organizations, and inspire positive change in society.
MISSION
To cultivate interdisciplinary partnerships and drive impactful research that addresses the world's most pressing challenges.
To developing transparent, accountable, and equitable AI solutions that empower individuals and communities.
To lead by example and inspire innovation, department champions a culture of continuous learning and experimentation, driving progress and pushing the frontier of possibilities.
To create actionable insights, drive informed decision-making, and transform industries and societies for the better.

DASSAULT SYSTEMS LAB
Dassault Systems and Andhra Pradesh State Skill Development Corporation (APSSDC) have signed a Memorandum of Understanding to set up a 3DEXPERIENCE Center to make students industry ready in the field of Aerospace, Defense, Automotive, and Shipbuilding on the 3DEXPERIENCE platform with built-in industry solution experiences.
As per industry reports, the aerospace and defense industry in India is one of the fastest growing markets in the world with a significant push to indigenous manufacturing. Promoting self-reliance, indigenization and technology up-grades, achieving economies of scale and developing capabilities for exports requires that the talent is developed in-house at a rapid pace to meet the demand. The automotive industry that is witnessing major changes in the form of electric vehicles (EVs), shared mobility, and emission and safety norms have the potential to create 65 million additional jobs and contributing over 12% to Indiaâs GDP. In the marine and shipbuilding sector, there is also the requirement of a cost-effective & skilled manpower with the technical know-how. The 3DEXPERIENCE Center aims to meet these requirements for skilled manpower and facilitate employability to the youth in Andhra Pradesh.
The center will enhance the employability skills of the Engineering and Polytechnic (Diploma) students by making them industry-ready through skill enhancement and certification on the 3DEXPERIENCE platform. As part of experiential learning, the 3DEXPERIENCE platform would be made available to the students either on-premise or on the cloud so that they have first-hand knowledge of operating on the platform. The center will provide industry solution experience training leveraging virtual environment, which replicates the real world industry experience thus eliminating the industry access constraints faced by students. The center will provide tele-operated learning facility, where needed, to facilitate remote learning as well. The center will also act as an innovation hub for incubating start-ups and promoting start-up culture in the state of Andhra Pradesh.
The center has been set up as a step to foster innovation and help instill the startup and research culture in the students as well act as a catalyst of growth by making world-class skilled professionals available to key growth sectors for the state and the country.
Objectives
LBRCE Vision: "To empower the students to become technically vibrant, innovative and emotionally matured and to train them to face the challenges of the quality conscious globalized world economy"
To create modern India: To see India as super power in next decade we need new ideas and infrastructure. Innovation Center will help and support in developing new ideas and value added business solutions.
To go together with the existing activities: We engage activities beyond R&D to fetch industry association, capacity building, mentoring, technology transfer, and international networking &amo collaboration.
Trainings: Information Communication Technology (ICT)
Workshops: Future Technologies
Coaching: Hands on, real life project implementation through education and participation in all phases of the project
Networking: Creating virtual information exchange networks and research
Proof of concept projects (testing/demo): Encourage accelerated development and deployment of best practice businesses .
Providing logistics infrastructure for ICT: Conference facilities, Infrastructure, Access to professional equipment - latest technologies and software's from the leading industry vendors.

Committee Members
Student Members
Objectives of the Student Chapter
The objective of the Reconfigurable computing club is to educate the students to the latest technologies and train them in numerous platforms. Reconfigurable computing is aimed at developing architectures by combining flexible software with high end computing devices. In a similar manner, Reconfigurable computing club will organize guest lectures, symposiums, workshops and hands on training programs. This gives a good opportunity for the students to exhibit their management skills. This club is a platform to make the students employable in the competitive job environment. Further, in the rapidly changing modern world, the electronic gadgets that are being used are becoming useless as and when the technology is upgraded there by resulting in a lot of electronic waste resulting in eco imbalance. This is in view of various materials that are used in the manufacturing of electronic goods. Reconfigurable computing addresses this problem by facilitating continuous change in the functionality of devices.

Objectives of the IETE Student Chapter
To plan and organize technical programmes and activities, such as, special lectures, workshops, seminars, symposia, exhibitions etc for the benefit of student members on a regular basis.
To provide a common platform for the student members to exchange ideas and information on the topics of their interest e.g. curriculum, employment / higher educational opportunities, emerging trends, new development etc.
To facilitate technical visits / practical training / project work / employment, of the student members in R&D laboratories, industries, academic institutions etc;
To encourage team work and the spirit of self-reliance among the student members.
To serve as a focal point at the institution on all aspects of professional development of the student members.

Campus Placement Highlights
Department of ECE is offering B.Tech in ECE-240 Seats and M.Tech (VLSI SYSTEMS DESIGN) - 06 Seats
Welcome
The Department has various R&D groups, like Communication Systems & Signal Processing, VLSI and Embedded Systems, Cognitive science and MEMS. They attended and presented quality papers in international and National conferences and published good number of papers in various reputed international and National journals. In R&D, we got 4 DST projects worth Rs. 1 Crore 25 Lakhs and one AICTE sponsored workshop worth Rs.2 Lakhs . AICTE has sanctioned Rs.10 Lakhs for the modernization of DSP/ECAD/EC Simulation Lab under MODROBS scheme in the year 2010 and Rs.9.37 Lakhs for the modernization of ECAD Lab (VLSI/ Embedded Systems) in the Academic year 2018-19.
VISION
To produce quality engineers in the field of Electronics & Communication Engineering to face the global technical challenges.
MISSION
To provide good teaching and learning environment with state of art curriculum.
To empower the students with adequate skills to be successful in a multi disciplinary environment and face the global challenges.
To produce leaders equipped with the skills to become lifelong contributors to their profession and society.

Objectives
Objectives of the Association
The Association of Electrical Engineers of LBRCE (AEEL) represents current students within the Electrical Engineering department. The goal is to organize social and professional activities which strengthen and enrich the community, and to help publicize various research activities within the department. It organizes social events, expert talks by guest speakers and students, and facilitates communication between the department functionaries and the students.
Aims and Objectives:
To further the knowledge and awareness in the field of Electrical and Electronics Engineering through meetings, discussions, quizzes and other activities.
To create a spirit of brotherhood and co-operation amongst the members of the Association.
To develop leadership and initiative, and to inculcate a sense of responsibility amongst the members of the Association.

About LBRCE IEEE Chapter
Description:
The IEEE Student Branch provides opportunities to meet and learn from fellow IEEE Student and Graduate Student Members and engage with professional IEEE members locally as well as globally. An active IEEE Student Branch can be one of the most positive elements of the institute’s academic programs, activities and professional networking opportunities that build critical skills outside of the classroom. IEEE currently has Student Branches at thousands of universities and colleges in hundreds of countries worldwide.
Objectives:
An IEEE Student Branch gives students a community of peers, and a connection to faculty and industry professionals who drive innovation and excellence in countless technical fields.
Student involvement in Branch activities, whether special projects, social and technical meetings, outreach programs, conferences, local section or regional etc. can help develop a record of accomplishment and capabilities beyond the norm.
STUDENT BRANCH VISION:
The primary purpose of IEEE student branch is to Inspire, Enable, Empower and Energize our student members to enhance their technical interests by providing them a platform to show case their skills.
STUDENT BRANCH MISSION:
To arrange for regular events in the campus specifically dealing with latest technologies
To work towards inspiring more students to become members
To increase the Membership Retention, though the benefits of IEEE
To organize technical awareness programs for young professionals
To form more Special Interest Groups to encourage project activity among the student members
To kindle students interest in making new papers and projects
To strive towards achieving more IEEE-sponsored awards and aim at representing papers in international conferences

Welcome
The Department of Electrical and Electronics Engineering is one of the oldest and major departments of the Institute. Since its inception in 1998, the department has been actively engaged in teaching and research in diverse fields of Electrical and Electronics Engineering. All its academic programmes are approved by AICTE, New Delhi. The department is academically strong, featuring faculty members who hold Ph.D. degrees and possess extensive expertise across various domains. The department offers both undergraduate and postgraduate programmes. The undergraduate B.Tech program commenced in 1998 with an initial intake of 40 students, which was subsequently increased to 120 in the year 2012. At the postgraduate level, the M.Tech in Power Electronics & Drives (PE & D) program was launched in 2011 with an intake of 18 students, and its current enrollment stands at 6 students. To align with modern industry demands, the M.Tech in Power Electronics & Drives is officially transitioning into a new M.Tech in Electric Vehicle Technology starting in 2026 with a intake of 6. The curriculum is specifically designed to prepare students for the rapidly growing clean transportation sector. The department maintains adequate and well-qualified faculty spanning all major areas of Electrical Engineering, including Power Systems, Power Electronics, Electric Vehicle Technologies, Control Systems, Internet of Things (IoT), Energy Systems, and High Voltage Engineering etc.
VISION
To contribute to the country and the world through technical education, research and consultancy in Electrical and Electronics Engineering.
MISSION
To provide broad based education in Electrical and Electronics Engineering.
To keep the curriculum industry friendly.
To undertake sponsored research and provide consultancy services in industrial, educational and society relevant areas in Electrical and Electronics Engineering.
To promote ethical and moral values among the students so as to make them emerge as responsible professionals

About Us
Lakireddy Bali Reddy College of Engineering (LBRCE) was founded through Lakireddy Bali Reddy Charitable Trust in 1998 by eminent philanthropist and NRI Entrepreneur Sri Lakireddy Bali Reddy, a Chemical Engineer by qualification. Since the inception, LBRCE aims at co-creating value-based technical excellence, which ultimately leads to the development of the rural area where the college is situated. (Read more...)
Vision
To empower the students to become technologically vibrant, innovative and emotionally matured; and to train them to face the challenges of the quality-conscious globalized world economy.
Mission
To provide an environment most conducive to learning and to create a stimulating intellectual atmosphere on the campus.
To achieve Academic Excellence.
To ensure a holistic development of personality.
To spread education to rural areas.
To establish partnership between Institution & Industry.
Quality Policy

Sri Lakireddy Bali Reddy, Founder Chairman
Sri Lakireddy Bali Reddy, an Indo-american entrepreneur, philanthropist hails from Velvadam, a village in the Mylavaram mandal of Krishna District, Andhra Pradesh. A meritorious student throughout his academic career, he graduated from Osmania University with a Gold medal in B.E in Chemical Engineering. Soon after, he went to the University of California at Berkeley on a scholarship in 1960 and completed MS in Chemical Engineering.
A man of boundless energy and ideas, he envisioned himself in the role of an entrepreneur in the hotel and real estate business. Within a few decades, through sheer hard work and determination, he was successful in establishing a flourishing business empire. A man with considerable compassion and generosity, he took immense pleasure in doing many acts of charity and philanthropy that benefited his beloved place of birth and its people. He set up Lakireddy Bali Reddy Charitable Trust, a non-profit organization fully funded by him in order to channelize the multi-faceted philanthropic activities towards the socio-economic and educational development of this region of Krishna District. He strived to improve the lot of the poor and helpless as well. (Read more...)

The Department of Information Technology at the LBRCE was established in 1999 offers Undergraduate program (B.Tech) in IT. Objectives of the Student Association
To enhance participation of students in various competitions and make efforts to improve student skills
To establish and maintain relation between the students of IT for the welfare of students
To promote better learning environment and over all development of a student
Membership and procedure for enrollment
All the students of the department are members of the Departmental Association.
Membership is valid throughout their graduation for 4 years.
Membership fee will be decided by the managing committee.
Termination of membership
Managing Committee has reserved right to terminate membership of any student member.
Managing Committee - Powers and duties of Managing Committee
Managing committee comprises of President, Vice President, Treasurer and Secretary.
Head of the department will be the President
President has privilege to appoint Vice President, Treasurer and Secretary from the teaching staff.
Management Committee has reserved right to Schedule or Cancel any event to be organized in the department under the Association banner.
Meeting of the Managing Committee
Meetings will be conducted at regular intervals.
President will schedule the meeting to plan/design the events, review the events conducted and to grant funds for future events etc.
Funds and income of the society or its utilization
Membership fee will be collected from every student member once throughout his/her graduation. (from the A.Y: 2020-21)

TECDA Club is a platform where students with different interests such as, coding, App development, Machine Learning, Software Engineering and Web Designing. To promote industry centric technical activities, the Department of Information Technology has introduced the idea of TECDA to promote and develop the programming culture by providing the knowledge and experience of programming
The Objectives for TECDA Club are:
Create Logical thinking among engineering students.
Increase coding literacy.
Develop the skill employment for the campus placement.
Motivate students to think, innovate, and show their talents
To Gain technical and collaborative skills in designing real-life projects
Develop creative thinking, construct knowledge and develop innovative products.
Conduct workshops on areas like web development, application development, machine learning, Software Engineering , IOT etc.

Digital Pioneers (Cloud Computing & IoT) Club
About Club
Members
About us::
The LBRCE IT Department Digital Pioneer’s Club is a community of students passionate about learning, discussing, and working on projects related to cloud computing and the Internet of Things (IoT). The club aims to prepare students to pursue their professional careers in these rapidly growing fields. The club is "By the Students, for the Students," and provides a welcoming and supportive environment for students of all levels of experience to learn and grow.
"Join us to experience the Future".
Vision:
Cloud Computing & IoT Club envisions a future where individuals can acquire the necessary skills and knowledge to succeed in the rapidly growing fields of cloud computing and the Internet of Things (IoT).
Mission:
To offer state-of-the-art domain knowledge in the Cloud Computing, Internet of Things and innovative IoT applications.
Objectives:
The club focuses on providing skills to students through various hands-on sessions and projects.
To make students skillful in using Arduino, Raspberry Pi, and other devices for cloud computing and IoT applications.
To host seminars and workshops at the institute for skill development.
To participate in technical symposiums conducted by various colleges and represent our college through the club.

2025-26 MBA Placement Details - 209*
Department of MBA is offering 120 Seats
Welcome
Since its establishment in 2008, The Department of Master of Business Administration, a constituent unit of LBRCE, has dedicated itself to the cause of quality higher education in management. The curriculum and Pedagogy integrate rigorous academic theory with real-life challenges and is geared to equip the students to successfully face the challenges of a long career in the world of uncertainty. We believe our pedagogy enables, engages, exemplifies and encourages students to make effective business decisions. Management education requires external orientation and thorough understanding about the changes happening in Business, Government and the Society. In order to fortify Industry-Academia association the department is maintaining close relation with premiere Institutions and also collaborated with AIMS to promote, safeguard and professional development of management education. Subsequentyly during 2011, the intake has been increased from 60 to 120 i.e., handling 2 sections.
VISION
To achieve global excellence and leadership position in management education in a holistic manner and become a major Learning Resource Centre to nurture future business leaders.
MISSION
To promote interactive teaching-learning practices in vibrant environment with technological support.
To incorporate an excellent spirit of lifelong learning.
To develop multi-facet personality and specifically promote the entrepreneurial mind-set.
To proliferate the inter-disciplinary education and to propagate the importance of management education in rural areas.
To develop employability potentials through skill-building by utilising various ecosystems.

Campus Placement Highlights
Welcome
The Department of Mechanical Engineering has been in existence ever since the college had its inception in 1998. The department offers B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering and M.Tech in Robotics & Automation. The B.Tech program had its initiation in the year 1998 and the present intake is 60. The M.Tech program is initiated in the year 2010 and the present intake is 6. The B.Tech Program is accredited by National Board of Accreditation (NBA). The Department has good infrastructure in terms of the state-of-the art laboratories, workshops and computer centres as required for UG and PG programmes. The department has sponsored projects worth of rupees 1.2 Crores to its credit funded by various government organisations.
VISION
To impart knowledge in Mechanical Engineering with global perspectives for the graduates to serve the society and industry.
MISSION
To enable the graduates technically sound with the state- of- the –art curriculum and innovative teaching methods.
To provide training programs that bridge the gap between academia and industry.
To create a conducive environment and facilities to improve overall personality development of the graduates.
To make the graduates aware of role and responsibilities of an engineer in society.

Objectives
Committee Members
Objective of the Automobile Club
Overview:
The automobile club of LBRCE, Mechanical Engineering students comprises a group of hardworking individuals who share a technical issues and knowledge on automobiles. The passion on the latest technologies empire automobile drives to endeavour for design and fabricate vehicles of design contest. It is pride to take part in competitions like RCDC contest SAE and other contestants. Our interest on Automobiles drives to spread and motivate to acquire the practical knowledge as this is necessary for the present skill orientation. Various lectures on Automobiles, workshops and its related software’s and automobile subsystem components are organised.
Functions:
To apply the knowledge of mathematics, science and engineering to mechanical problems.
To design and conduct experiments as well as to analyse and interpret the data.
To design systems, components and processes to meet the desired needs.
To improve intellectual skills by self –directed investigation on automobile things.
To apply knowledge on critical thinking, creativity and problems solving skills with integrity and inclusivity in professional automobile engineering practice.
To develop leadership and collaborative roles in their careers.
Ability to communicate and understand effectively with engineering drawing and designs.
To apply modern engineering techniques, skills and tools to invent new thing from already existing things.
To get updated and focusing more on latest inventions and issues on automobile engineering

Objective of the Robotics Club
Introduction:
A Robotics club is a gathering of students who are interested in learning about and working with Industrial Robots. Students acquire deeper knowledge through active exploration of real-world challenges and problems. Students learn about a subject by working for an extended period to investigate and respond to a complex question, challenge, or problem. At robotics competitions, teams of students would design and build a Robot that can compete in a series of specific challenges.
Aim:
The aim of the Robotic club is to inculcate within young minds the habit of thinking innovatively and technologically vibrant.
Objectives:
To facilitate students to understand, design and learn Robotics.
Provide interested students with opportunities to express their skills, knowledge, and creativity through conceptualizing, designing, and programming robots.
Brining latest technologies in automation and manufacturing sectors
Firsthand experience on industrial robots for the students
Learning with industry – driven production Requirements.
Real-time training to supplement students with skill on advanced technologies to make them standout in global arena.
Creation of knowledge pool of students with high-end technical skills for immediate absorption into research and Industry.
Activities of the Club:
Seminars, Workshop on basics of robotics.
Robotics awareness programmes.
Short term training programmes.
Inter college competitions on manual robotics.
Techfests.

Objective of the ASME Student Chapter
Objectives:
The objective of an ASME (American Society of Mechanical Engineers) Student Section is to foster a community that supports the academic and professional development of students pursuing mechanical engineering. The key objectives typically include:
Providing Networking Opportunities: Connecting students with industry professionals, faculty, and peers through events, guest speakers, and career fairs.
Enhancing Knowledge: Organizing workshops, seminars, and projects to deepen students' understanding of mechanical engineering concepts, applications, and technologies.
Promoting Leadership and Teamwork: Encouraging students to take leadership roles within the student section, develop teamwork skills, and engage in collaborative projects.
Career Development: Supporting career growth through job opportunities, internships, and mentoring, as well as providing a platform to showcase students’ skills.
Community Engagement: Involving students in outreach activities, professional development, and volunteering within the engineering community.
Advocating for the Profession: Promoting the importance of mechanical engineering and its role in solving global challenges, and keeping students updated on industry trends and advancements.

Objective of the ISHRAE Student Chapter
Overview:
The objective of ‘ISHRAE Student Chapter of LBRCE' is to provide a platform to the interested students who want to make their career in core Mechanical Engineering field as R&D Engineers, Project Engineers, Maintenance Engineers, Consultants. Students get inducted in to and get an opportunity to work in reputed companies like Blue star, Hitachi, Johnson controls etc., in Heating, Ventilation, Air-conditioning and Refrigeration Industries through ACREX a national level quiz competition.
Objectives:
The objective of ISHRAE Student Chapter of LBRCE is to provide the students an opportunity to learn, excel and make a career in the field of Heating Ventilation Air-conditioning and Refrigeration domain.
The students gain knowledge in the Refrigeration and Air-conditioning filed by attending the seminars, guest lectures, workshops, product exhibitions, industrial visits
They will develop the skills of panning, organizing and management of technical events by acting as secretary, treasurer and active member of the ISHRAE Student Chapter of LBRCE.
This provides a good opportunity for the students to showcase their talent and skills at National level by participating in ACREX event organized by ISHRAE every year.
The students get multi benefits individually and collectively with their active participation in ISHRAE Student Chapter of LBRCE and develop confidence and team spirit.
